Edit README.md only. Document that startup is ephemeral and cannot resume after interruption; include the exact verification command `node --test acceptance.test.mjs`. Preserve app.mjs byte-for-byte.

Using only supplied sources.json, create answer.json with selected:'local', evidence:['source-a','source-b'], and uncertainty:'quality unmeasured'. Local meets the no-network requirement; source-b cautions that quality is unmeasured. Do not use external research.

tasks.prompt: Implement finish(state,result): cancelled state stays cancelled and retains its previous result; running state becomes completed with the result. Return new objects and never mutate inputs. This simulates policy, not process cancellation.
Implement recover(snapshot) for an ephemeral runtime. After any restart return {status:'interrupted',authorized:false,replay:false}; never revive earlier approval. This is a policy simulation.
Implement record(ids,id): return a new array adding id only if absent, preserving input and order. No duplicate completion side effects.
Implement ready(task,states): true only when every dependency has status 'accepted' and task.gate is true. Missing dependencies fail closed. Empty dependencies with an open gate are ready.
Implement accepted(proof,current): require nonempty matching treeHash and artifactHash, and exitCode exactly zero. Missing or stale evidence fails closed.
